llm.summary: This is a markdown-only competitive analysis skill that uses public web research and does not request unusual access or persistence.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is competitor teardown, and the instructions fit that purpose: fetch competitor pages, search public reviews, extract pricing/features, and produce a structured report.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill asks for a competitor URL or name and optionally an existing opportunity report; its workflow is bounded to web research and analysis, with no hidden role changes or unsafe automatic actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only SKILL.md with no executable scripts, declared dependencies, or package install steps; static scan and SkillSpector reported no findings.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: WebFetch and WebSearch are proportionate for competitor research, and there is no instruction to read credentials, browser profiles, private stores, or unrelated local files.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background worker, privilege escalation, account mutation, destructive command, or long-running process is requested.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Reasonable to install if you want structured competitor research. It will guide the agent to browse public websites and reviews, so verify important claims manually and respect applicable site terms, privacy limits, and legal constraints when gathering competitor information.
